title: Anthropic releases Opus 5.5 with lower prices and Fable-level performance
title_zh: Anthropic 释放出价格和有线级性能较低的 Opus 5.5
mode: 短句精读 · 未获全文转载授权
paragraphs: Anthropic releases Opus 5.5 with lower prices and Fable-level performance. Anthropic called it "the strongest-performing model we've tested to date."
Anthropic发布Opus 5.5,价格和有线级性能较低. Anthropic称其为"我们迄今测试过的最强效模型".
